hypotheses_read.zh: 经识回应（Flow.RespondsThroughRegistration）是给出的前提，不由动力学推出；它要求部分之外的形成在识得相同之处与每个条件的交换相同，排除对未被识者的回应、噪声与未表示为条件的外来输入。定律只在回应所及之外用到它。
hypotheses_read.en: Responding through registration (Flow.RespondsThroughRegistration) is a supplied premise, not derived from the dynamics; it asks that formations outside the part exchange alike with every condition wherever they have registered alike, which excludes responding to what is not registered, noise, and outside inputs not represented as conditions. The laws use it only beyond the responsive reach.

hypotheses_new.zh: 经识回应（Flow.RespondsThroughRegistration）在本记录的定律中是给出的前提，定律只在回应所及之外用到它；它排除对未被识者的回应、噪声与未表示为条件的外来输入。其余遵从一个只读各形成所识的交换律时，它对律的任意两个进程是定理（ExchangeLaw.Through.responds，见 counterfactual-is-the-course）；每个读已立者的律经识一切而读，条件有限时经其敏感而读（ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_sensitive），取律的敏感为识时，那些回应落在识之内，回应所及随之变宽。这时仍取的假设：交换律本身；它读已立者（ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating）；第二个流为另一动作生成的进程时，进程可行（ExchangeLaw.Feasible，等价于它平衡）；敏感的形式还要条件有限、条件的相等可判定。
hypotheses_new.en: Responding through registration (Flow.RespondsThroughRegistration) is a supplied premise in this record's laws, which use it only beyond the responsive reach; it excludes responding to what is not registered, noise, and outside inputs not represented as conditions. Where the rest follows a law of exchange reading only what each formation registers, it is a theorem for any two courses of the law (ExchangeLaw.Through.responds, counterfactual-is-the-course); every law of what has stood reads through registering everything, and with finitely many conditions through its sensitivity (ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_sensitive), and with the law's sensitivity as the registration those responses fall within it and the responsive reach widens. The hypotheses then still taken: the law of exchange itself; that it reads what has stood (ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating); with the second flow the course another act generates, that course's feasibility (ExchangeLaw.Feasible, equivalent to its balance); and for the sensitivity form, finitely many conditions with decidable equality.

回应由动力学给出的比较见 counterfactual-is-the-course（交换律与它读已立者仍是给出的）；
a comparison whose responses the dynamics give rather than supply stays open;
a comparison whose responses the dynamics give is in counterfactual-is-the-course (the law of exchange and that it reads what has stood remain supplied);

detail.zh: 推出本记录的前提：其余遵从一个只读各形成所识的交换律时，其余经识回应是定理；第二个流是另一动作生成的进程，比较不另给第二个流与回应；Loop.responds 由律推出（Loop.responds_by_law）。
detail.en: Derives this record's premise: where the rest follows a law of exchange reading only what each formation registers, responding through registration is a theorem; the second flow is the course another act generates, so the comparison supplies neither the second flow nor the response; Loop.responds follows from the law (Loop.responds_by_law).

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P80：其余遵从一个只读各形成所识的交换律时，经识回应对律的任意两个进程是定理（ExchangeLaw.Through.responds）；条件有限时识可取作律的敏感（ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_sensitive）；第二个流可以是另一动作生成的、可行的进程（comparison_with_act）；Loop.responds 由律推出（Becoming.Counterfactual，counterfactual-is-the-course）。仍给出的：交换律、它读已立者、进程可行。hypotheses 第一项、limitations 与 next_delta 随之修订；见整合文档 §{S}。断言不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P80: where the rest follows a law of exchange reading only what each formation registers, responding through registration is a theorem for any two courses of the law (ExchangeLaw.Through.responds); with finitely many conditions the registration may be the law's sensitivity (ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_sensitive); the second flow may be the feasible course another act generates (comparison_with_act); Loop.responds follows from the law (Becoming.Counterfactual, counterfactual-is-the-course). Still supplied: the law of exchange, that it reads what has stood, feasibility. The first hypothesis, the limitations and next_delta revised accordingly; see §{S} of the integration note. The assertion is unchanged.

next_delta_read.zh: 他者有回应时，不另给“其余只经其识回应”这一前提、由动力学给出回应的比较（在该前提下，P65 把比较定在回应所及之内，见 comparison-where-the-rest-responds）；到达回应所及之内的差别有多少；中心怎样表示其所及；Ren 的判断：影响闭包是否读出形成自身的反馈。
next_delta_read.en: With others responding, a comparison whose responses the dynamics give without supplying that the rest responds only through its registration (under that premise P65 decides the comparison within the responsive reach, comparison-where-the-rest-responds); how much difference arrives within the responsive reach; how a center represents what it reaches; Ren's judgment whether the influence closure reads a formation's own feedback.

next_delta.zh: 他者有回应时，到达回应所及之内的差别有多少；中心怎样表示其所及；Ren 的判断：影响闭包是否读出形成自身的反馈。（由动力学给出回应的比较：其余遵从一个读已立者的交换律时，P65 的经识回应是定理，比较在回应所及之内决定，不另给第二个流与回应，见 comparison-where-the-rest-responds 与 counterfactual-is-the-course；交换律本身仍是给出的。）
next_delta.en: With others responding, how much difference arrives within the responsive reach; how a center represents what it reaches; Ren's judgment whether the influence closure reads a formation's own feedback. (A comparison whose responses the dynamics give: where the rest follows a law of exchange reading what has stood, P65's response premise is a theorem and the comparison is decided within the responsive reach with neither the second flow nor the response supplied, comparison-where-the-rest-responds and counterfactual-is-the-course; the law of exchange itself remains supplied.)

detail.zh: 回答本记录 next_delta 中由动力学给出回应的比较，在其余遵从读已立者的交换律时。
detail.en: Answers this record's next_delta item of a comparison whose responses the dynamics give, where the rest follows a law of exchange reading what has stood.

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P80：他者有回应的比较由动力学给出：其余遵从一个读已立者的交换律时，一个动作的反事实是它生成的进程（恰在可行时存在，由动作固定），P65 的经识回应是定理，比较在回应所及之内决定而不另给第二个流与回应（Becoming.Counterfactual，counterfactual-is-the-course）。交换律与它读已立者是给出的；next_delta 随之修订；见整合文档 §{S}。断言不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P80: the comparison with others responding as the dynamics give: where the rest follows a law of exchange reading what has stood, the counterfactual of an act is the course it generates (existing exactly where feasible, fixed by the act), P65's response premise is a theorem, and the comparison is decided within the responsive reach with neither the second flow nor the response supplied (Becoming.Counterfactual, counterfactual-is-the-course). The law of exchange and that it reads what has stood are supplied; next_delta revised accordingly; see §{S} of the integration note. The assertion is unchanged.

detail.zh: 一个实例：部分的动作为输入、其余遵从交换律时，进程是 inputs 的轨道，未取的动作是干预。
detail.en: An instance: with the part's move as the input and the rest following a law of exchange, the course is a trajectory of inputs, and an act not taken is an intervention.

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P80：一个实例：部分做一列动作、其余遵从交换律时，生成的历史是以部分的动作为输入、无噪声的 inputs 的轨道（ExchangeLaw.course_trajectory），未取的动作是干预（ExchangeLaw.act_not_taken，inputs_intervention_unfixed 与 inputs_model_fixes 的实例）（Becoming.Counterfactual，counterfactual-is-the-course）；见整合文档 §{S}。断言不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P80: an instance: where the part makes a list of moves and the rest follows a law of exchange, the generated history is a trajectory of inputs with the part's move as the input and no noise (ExchangeLaw.course_trajectory), and an act not taken is an intervention (ExchangeLaw.act_not_taken, an instance of inputs_intervention_unfixed and inputs_model_fixes) (Becoming.Counterfactual, counterfactual-is-the-course); see §{S} of the integration note. The assertion is unchanged.

detail.zh: 实例（P80b）：交换律的进程是一个世界，按交换之律而行恰当可行；确定的律在 Shown 之外的步恰在运行未取的动作（Run.beyond_shown_iff，关于 Shown 的一条律，暂放在 Counterfactual），所以进程历史之外的是反事实；部分的动作由律在配置上形成时，closedBy 的运行就是进程。
detail.en: Instances (P80b): the course of a law of exchange is a world, running by the law of exchange exactly where feasible; a determined law's steps beyond Shown are exactly at the moves the run never takes (Run.beyond_shown_iff, a law about Shown, kept in Counterfactual for now), so what lies beyond the course's history is its counterfactuals; with the part's move formed by a law on the configuration, a run of closedBy is the course.

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P80（并入 P80b）：实例：交换律的进程是一个世界（ExchangeLaw.world、ExchangeLaw.world_exchange_iff）；确定的律在运行所显示者之外的步恰在运行未取的动作（Run.beyond_shown_iff，关于 Shown 的一条律，按整合者的安排暂放在 Becoming.Counterfactual，第二个模块需要时移入 Unfolding，名字与陈述不变），所以进程历史之外的是反事实（ExchangeLaw.counterfactual_beyond_shown）；部分的动作由律在配置上形成时，closedBy 的运行就是进程（ExchangeLaw.closedBy_course）（counterfactual-is-the-course）。何时一个动作是部分自己的，仍不推出；next_delta 不变；见整合文档 §{S}。断言不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P80 (P80b folded in): instances: the course of a law of exchange is a world (ExchangeLaw.world, ExchangeLaw.world_exchange_iff); a determined law's steps beyond what a run shows are exactly at the moves the run never takes (Run.beyond_shown_iff, a law about Shown, kept in Becoming.Counterfactual as the integrator arranged, moving to Unfolding, name and statement kept, when a second module needs it), so what lies beyond the course's history is its counterfactuals (ExchangeLaw.counterfactual_beyond_shown); with the part's move formed by a law on the configuration, a run of closedBy is the course (ExchangeLaw.closedBy_course) (counterfactual-is-the-course). When a move is the part's own is still not derived; next_delta unchanged; see §{S} of the integration note. The assertion is unchanged.
